mostWorthwhile.text: The Tuesday test and revised rule were the strongest passage: a specific wrongly refused pickup led to a practical human review route.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the talkbox components was straightforward and somewhat repetitive, even if the accessibility and listening details gave it purpose.

surprise.text: The rule treated a two-carrier pickup as impossible because it could book only one volunteer; the fresh test then showed review helping with a different timing problem.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the talkbox fittings were predictable and offered no meaningful choice once the routing goal was complete.

continue.text: Yes. The concrete failures and human corrections made me curious how the neighborhood will handle the wider directory problem, although I would hope for more meaningful choices than the linear repair sequence.
